programme.title: Paragliding - World Cup
programme.desc: The Paragliding World Cup Superfinal was staged in Roldanillo, Colombia with ten days of high level competition flying in one of the best paragliding venues in the world. One-hundred and twenty-two pilots competed, including 18 previous overall World Cup winners and 12 Women World Cup winners, ranking it as one of the toughest line-ups ever to face each other. Suspended in the air, this adventure sport features cross-country racing, with pilots needing to be an expert in understanding the impact of terrain on weather conditions.

programme.title: Salomon Gore - Tex Maxi Race

The Salomon Gore-Tex Maxi Race is one of the best and most demanding trail running events, staged in the stunning lake and mountain scenery of the Haute Savoie.

programme.title: Andalucia Bike Race - 2019
programme.desc: The Andalucia Bike Race is Spain's premier mountain bike race, and one of the most outstanding in the world as recognized by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). Incorporating six stages over six days, the race weaves its way up and down the Andalucia mountains at a blistering pace, routing through spectacular trails and sensational views. Elite and masters race categories offer individual and team leader board standings, with daily stage prizes, overall medals and prize money for the elite UCI riders. The pace of the competition never slows across the six stages, kicking off with the stage 1 time trial; a short, fast and intense 'flash stage', featuring single tracks mixed with overtaking sections. Five days, 32 kilometres and over 6,590 meters of ascent later, the 57.8km "finisher" stage 6 is the final test, as riders climb over 1,396 meters up the mythical Reventón and pass through Trasierra, before descending and finishing along Santo Domingo's unforgettable single-track...

programme.desc: With Mindy depressed about not getting a scholarship, it's up to Mork to stir up some laughs, so he brings home a friend who claims to be the real Peter Pan, with the power to fly as just one of his magical talents.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Dueling Skates
programme.desc: It's the biggest, funniest roller marathon ever when Mork takes to skates for the first time to race a cheating champion skater down a Rocky Mountain peak into Boulder to save the day care center at which he works from destruction.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Mork the Prankster
programme.desc: Spaceman Mork gets so cosmically carried away with pulling practical jokes that he surprises Mindy by assembling her jeep in their living room right over Mr. Bickley's apartment - with disastrous results.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Mork, The Monkey's Uncle
programme.desc: Mork turns the apartment he shares with Mindy into a hilarious hideaway for a young chimpanzee that he kidnaps from the Boulder zoo in the mistaken belief that the animal's mother has been abducted.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Mork's New Look
programme.desc: Mork sends the face-lifting business into orbit when he hilariously rushes to a plastic surgeon to shoot the works after Mindy gives Mork the idea that everyone could use a little improverrent on Mork & Mindy.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Mork and The Bum Rap
programme.desc: Naive Mork puts on his own out-of-this-world telethon to help Mindy raise charity funds, but is such a funny failure at fund-raising that he turns to his own outrageous brand of panhandling to come up with the needed money.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: There's A New Mork In Town
programme.sub-title: There's A New Mork In Town
programme.desc: Mork faces almost unbeatable competition for his job as official Earth observer from his Orkan hero, the suave and charming Xerko, who beams to Earth to challenge Mork to an outrageous contest for the right to send reports back to Ork.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Mork Meets Robin Williams
programme.desc: Mork, who has never heard of Robin Williams and scoffs at the idea of resembling him, gets crushed by mobs of fans who think he is the popular comedian, then has a hilarious nose-to-nose encounter with the famous star.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Mindy, Mindy, Mindy
programme.desc: Mork, lonely in Mindy's absence, sets the stage for amazing comical confusion when he gets the visiting Orkan Elder to clone multiple Mindys which he continues to do until he gets it right.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Mork The Swinging Single
programme.desc: Mindy is convinced that she has unleashed the swingingest single ever after she persuades Mork that it would inprove their relationship if each began dating new people and he turns into the hilarious new king of Boulder's social scene.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Mork and The Family Reunion
programme.desc: When Mindy eats one of Mork's gourmet delights, she turns into a wacky Orkan herself, sending her family reunion into a rollicking tizzy and treating pompous old Uncle Dave (special guest star Jonathan Winters) to a bizarre evening he won't forget.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: I Heard It Through The Morkvine
programme.sub-title: I Heard It Through The Morkvine
programme.desc: Mork, who doesn't understand why people gossip, reveals some hilarious inside scoops when he shows and tells all about his friends while subbing for Mindy as host of a local TV show called Rumor Has It.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Mindy and Mork
programme.desc: When Mindy has to work long hours on a new TV call-in show, Mork has to help with the housework. But when his comedic cleaning efforts turn the apartment into a disaster area, he calls up Mindy, on the air, for a new set of instructions.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Regrets and Reflections
programme.desc: Mr. Bickley's 50th birthday celebration turns into a crazy exchange of everybody's deepest secrets, but Mindy waits until the group leaves to tell Mork somthing she's wanted to say for years.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: The Wedding
programme.desc: Mindy is the beautiful bride and Mork is the outrageously funny groom - who may not be able to fit into his tuxedo if he can't convince Orson to approve the marriage and undo his transformation of Mork into an English sheep dog.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Three The Hard Way
programme.desc: Mork and unsuspecting Mindy hatch a comedy plot that's bigger than both of them when an egg emerges from Mork's navel that grows and grows until it bursts open and out pops their full-grown, middle-aged-looking son.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Mama Mork, Papa Mindy
programme.desc: Mindy is dazed at the reality that she and Mork are the parents of Mearth -half-earthling/half-orkan with the body of a 50-year-old and the mind of an infant and feels lef t out when Mearth accepts Mork as his mommy.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: PS 2001
programme.desc: Mearth hates his first day of school on planet Ork so much that Mork and Mindy accompany him back to Ork Prep, where Mork's ancient teacher - who looks like a child - is still sternly in charge.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Metamorphosis - The TV Show
programme.desc: Mindy, already worried about losing her job at the television station, foresees disaster when Mork and Mearth accidentally transfer minds, forcing her to take Mearth in Mork’s body to meet the new boss.

programme.title: The Seeds of Violence 1918-1922
programme.desc: Hatred and the desire for revenge smoldered in the minds of many Germans after the First World War. Many Germans believe that the Jews are the cause of all kinds of problems.

programme.title: Deceit and Delusion 1923-1928
programme.desc: Hitler and his movement seem to be eliminated after his failed putsch on November 9, 1923, the movement is banned, the self-proclaimed leaders are imprisoned.

programme.title: Democracy without Democrats 1929-1933
programme.desc: In the late 1920s, Germany was seething. Social protest turns into a racist and anti-Jewish movement, Hitler and his NSDAP using their anger against the “system” for their own benefits.

programme.title: The Racial State 1933-1934
programme.desc: After the 1933 parliament fire, President Hindenburg signs a decree that suspends freedom of speech. In mock elections, Hitler secures approval; with terror, he intimi-dates his adversaries.

programme.title: Hidden in Plain Sight 1935-1938
programme.desc: In October 1934, Hitler's government is firmly in the saddle. The majority of Germans support Hitler's offensive anti-Jewish policy.

programme.title: Up in Flames 1936-1940
programme.desc: At the end of 1939, the German Army has invaded Poland. They are followed closely by the SS (Schutzstaffel) task forces, which have only one mission: To murder the Polish intelligence.

programme.title: Auschwitz One Day
programme.desc: Harrowing testimonials from victims show how in 1944 the SS stepped up the “efficiency” of the death factory at Auschwitz and how the perpetrators documented their “work”.

programme.title: The Royals, the British Aristocracy and the Nazis
programme.desc: "The Royals, the British Aristocracy and the Nazis" presents documents and footage proving the royal family’s and leading British aristocrats’ sympathy for National Socialism.

programme.title: The Moon Landing and the Nazis
programme.desc: The film "The Moon Landing and the Nazis" documents the involvement of German NASA employees with the Third Reich.

programme.title: Concrete Against Bombs
programme.desc: The first programme features four bunkers built before World War Two. We begin with the legendary Franzensfeste in today’s northern Italy, a fortress that was never besieged.

programme.title: Facing Nuclear Annihilation
programme.desc: The second programme features shelters in the nuclear era in Lithuania, Germany and Albania.

programme.title: What if Hitler Had Won the War
programme.desc: The documentary addresses the counterfactual question of a Nazi victory in the Second World War and is asking at the same time how history would have evolved without Hitler.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: 3 wins to come out on top, who's it going to be? Rico Verhoeven, Levi Rigters, Tarik Osaro, Benjamin Adegbuyi, Sofian Laidouni, Uku Jurjendal, Bahram Rajabzadeh, and Nabil Khachab pair up and throw down for the GLORY Heavyweight Grand Prix, an 8-man 1-night heavyweight tournament for the ages.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The GLORY welterweight title will be on the line in the main event as the reigning & defending champion Endy Semeleer (35-1, 17 KO) welcomes the challenge of top contender Chico Kwasi (42-5, 22 KO). In the co-main event, after his crazy GLORY Heavyweight Grand Prix performance, the wild & exciting Bahram Rajabzadeh (66-2, 58 KO) steps down to light heavyweight and meets the hard-hitting Paris-based Kevin Oumar (33-4, 7 KO), a French kickboxing champion & budding MMA star. Belgian-Moroccan superstar Youssef Boughanem (187-43-8, 119 KO) steps into the GLORY ring for the very first time in his illustrious career as he meets the Ukraine’s Stanislav Kazantsev (25-8-1, 7 KO). The best of French kickboxing will be on display throughout the rest of the card as a host of the nation’s top stars will be in action against opponents from all over the world.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Endy Semeleer (35-1, 17 KO) will put his GLORY welterweight title on the line against ‘House of GLORY’ winner Anwar Ouled-Chaib (3-0) in the main event. In the co-main event, local fan favourite Nabil Khachab (26-4-1, 4 KO) finally gets his opportunity to enter the GLORY Grand Prix as he goes up against Serbia’s Nikola Filipovic (11-2, 6 KO) in a qualifying fight. Number one ranked Enriko Kehl (52-15-2, 30 KO) will be aiming undeniably book his spot as the next title challenger against champion Tyjani Beztati. The German meets the dangerous Arman Hambaryan (58-8-2, 27 KO) of Armenia.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The eight-man one-night GLORY Light Heavyweight Grand Prix will crown the baddest light heavyweight striker on the planet. The eight participants are: GLORY champion, #C Tarik Khbabez (58-10-1, 28 KO), Morocco. Former champion, #1 Donegi Abena (27-10, 7 KO), Suriname. Former champion, #2 Sergej Maslobojev (38-6, 23 KO), Lithuania. Undefeated in GLORY, #3 Stefan Latescu (17-2, 8 KO), Romania. ‘Mister Cool’ #4 Ibrahim El Bouni (41-9-1, 22 KO), Morocco. The wild & unpredictable, #5 Bahram Rajabzadeh (67-2, 59 KO), Azerbaijan. Top French light heavyweight, #6 Pascal Toure (20-6, 7 KO), France. Veteran fighter, #7 Bogdan Stoica (58-14, 40 KO), Romania.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The welterweight superfight between former GLORY world champion Endy Semeleer (36-2, 18 KO) and current GLORY lightweight world champion Tyjani Beztati (26-4, 9 KO) will take center stage in the main event of the evening. After dominating the lightweight division, Beztati moves up to welterweight for the very first time in his GLORY career. GLORY featherweight world champion Petch (169-40-3, 27 KO) and RISE national champion Kento Haraguchi (25-3-1, 14 KO) made their trilogy fight official for the co-main event. Two former middleweight title challengers collide as the number one ranked Michael Boapeah (17-4-1, 7 KO) takes on the number three ranked Ulric Bokeme (32-5, 17 KO), both fighters chasing a rematch at champion Donovan Wisse. Top Dutch star Tayfun Özcan (86-10-3, 28 KO) will make his highly anticipated GLORY debut against French champion Majid Amarouche (25-2-1, 10 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The main event will see two of the light heavyweight division’s most explosive young prospects clash as Romania’s Stefan Latescu (17-3, 8 KO) faces Turkey’s Cem Caceres (16-1, 13 KO). Belgium based Albanian Berjan Peposhi (29-4, 16 KO) will compete in the co-main event. The always exciting featherweight welcomes rising star Ayoub Bourass (14-1, 4 KO) in to make his GLORY debut. International Muay Thai superstar Youssef Boughanem (188-43-8, 120 KO) returns for his sophomore GLORY outing against tough Italian Angelo Volpe (38-5, 12 KO). Former middleweight title contender Serkan Ozcaglayan (45-10, 36 KO) takes on Antwerp’s own Jente Nnamadim (21-5, 11 KO), who comes in to make his GLORY debut in his hometown.

GLORY featherweight world champion Petch (169-40-3, 27 KO) and RISE national champion Kento Haraguchi (25-3-1, 14 KO) made their trilogy fight official for the co-main event. Two former middleweight title challengers collide as the number one ranked Michael Boapeah (17-4-1, 7 KO) takes on the number three ranked Ulric Bokeme (32-5, 17 KO), both fighters chasing a rematch at champion Donovan Wisse. Top Dutch star Tayfun Özcan (86-10-3, 28 KO) will make his highly anticipated GLORY debut against French champion Majid Amarouche (25-2-1, 10 KO).

programme.desc: 1932 Romance starring Gary Cooper and Helen Hayes. A passionate romance blooms between a wounded American soldier and a brave nurse amidst the chaos and heartache of World War I.

programme.title: The Double
programme.desc: Richard Gere stars as a retired CIA operative who is brought back to hunt the killer of a US Senator in this thriller.

programme.title: Monte Walsh
programme.desc: 2003 Western with Tom Selleck and Isabella Rossellini. Times are a-changing in the Wild West as the 20th century rushes in - but is it the end of the rope for quintessential cowboy Monte Walsh?

programme.title: Johnson County War - Part 2
programme.desc: 2002 Contemporary western with Tom Berenger, Luke Perry and Burt Reynolds. Three brothers are pulled into a fiery conflict between old cowboys and new homesteaders. 2/2

programme.title: Mclintock!
programme.desc: Western starring John Wayne, Maureen O'Hara and Patrick Wayne. A wealthy rancher must navigate warring factions in the Wild West while also fighting to save his troubled marriage.

programme.title: Abilene Town
programme.desc: Western with Randolph Scott, Edgar Buchanan and Lloyd Bridges. As tensions build between unruly cattlemen and determined homesteaders in post-Civil War Kansas, can one man keep the peace?

programme.title: An Organized Killer
programme.desc: Thriller with Allison McAtee. Needing help with her full but chaotic life, Grace hires a live-in assistant. And once Lilith is invited in, there's nothing she won't do... to get what she wants.

programme.title: Pretty Little Stalker
programme.desc: A troubled young girl grows obsessed with the author of a series of self-help books, who has recently become her neighbour. Starring Nicky Whelan 2018

programme.title: Killer In Law
programme.desc: 2018 High-stakes thriller with Kelly Sullivan. Melissa encounters the in-law from hell when her husband's long-lost mother returns. As she unleashes a twisted plan, someone is not needed any more...

programme.title: I Do, Or Die: A Killer Arrangement
programme.desc: Thriller starring Ana Golja. When Sonya finds out her traditional Romani parents have arranged a marriage for her, till death do us part takes on a whole new meaning...

programme.title: The Black Widow Killer
programme.desc: Thriller starring Erin Karpluk. Twenty-five years ago, a car accident resulted in the near-death of a teenage girl. Now she's back to exact dark and lethal revenge on everyone involved...

programme.title: Deadliest Switch
programme.desc: Thriller starring Lindsay Hartley. Two families are thrown into crisis when they discover their daughters were switched at birth - but nothing will stop one mother keeping what's hers...

programme.title: The Wild Geese
programme.desc: 1978 A-list action adventure with Richard Burton, Roger Moore and Richard Harris. The heat is on for the Wild Geese as they parachute into a hostile African nation to rescue its imprisoned leader...

programme.title: The Quick And The Dead
programme.desc: 1963 War drama starring Victor French and Majel Barrett. With the aid of local partisans, a group of American soldiers try to make it through enemy-occupied Italy to safety.

programme.title: A Winter Getaway
programme.desc: Great Romance offers a diverse lineup of narrative content centered around romance, including feature films and episodic series that highlight heartfelt stories, human connections, and emotional story

programme.title: Falling In Love At Christmas
programme.desc: Business rivals Miranda and Paul unknowingly meet at a Santa themed fancy-dress party. But will their feelings towards each other alter when their identities are revealed? Stars Travis Nelson. 2021

programme.title: The Mistletoe Promise
programme.desc: 2016 Romance starring Jaime King. Two Christmas haters agree to navigate the season together - but with the magic of the season beginning to take hold, will love also be on the cards?

programme.title: A Family For The Holidays
programme.desc: Sequel to 'Finding Father Christmas'. Miranda is exited to return to Vermont and spend Christmas with Ian and her long-lost family. But will a chance meeting threaten her future happiness? 2017

programme.title: Christmas in the Air
programme.desc: Robert, a widower and father of two children, enlists Lydia to help him juggle his chaotic work-life balance at Christmastime. Will their close relationship lead to love? Stars Catherine Bell. 2017

programme.title: Welcome To Christmas
programme.desc: 2018 Festive romance with Eric Mabius. Developer Madison visits Christmas, Colorado, for a ski resort development plan but finds community and holiday magic. Will progress threaten the town's charm?

programme.title: If Only We Had Christmas
programme.desc: 2020 Festive romance starring Candace Cameron Bure. When a publicist teams up with a cynical VP to help a charity in need, will a surprise revelation put paid to their promising romance?

programme.title: A Christmas Switch
programme.desc: 2018 Struggling singer Audrey loves Christmas, but wealthy record executive Julie just sees it as another reason to shop. The two women have nothing in common until a freak accident strikes.

programme.title: A Date By Christmas
programme.desc: 2019 Christmas romance with Vanessa Lengies. When the dating app she created grants her magical powers, can Chelsea use her abilities to help the 'naughty' people in her life onto the nice list?

programme.title: A Christmas Mission
programme.desc: 2020 Festive romance with Mary Antonini and Michael Xavier. Emma is reluctant to come home for Christmas despite her General dad's wishes. Can an old flame back from active duty change her mind?

programme.title: Deliver By Christmas
programme.desc: 2020 Romance with Alvina August and Eion Bailey. Baker Molly is charmed by town newcomer Josh and a customer she's only met by phone. But do her suitors have more in common than she thinks?

programme.title: A Christmas To Cherish
programme.desc: 2019 Heartwarming holiday drama with Peter Porte. A couple preparing to celebrate the perfect Christmas together must swap the fireside eggnog for a fight to save the beloved local community centre.

programme.title: Forever Christmas
programme.desc: A workaholic reality TV producer starts working on a new show about a sexy guy who celebrates Christmas every day, she finds herself falling for her mysterious new star. Starring Chelsea Hobbs 2019

programme.title: A Storybook Christmas
programme.desc: 2019 Christmas romance with Ali Liebert. When event planner Celeste calls in help to give her niece the perfect Christmas, will the nanny agency's unexpected choice be perfect for her too?

programme.title: Hearts Of Christmas
programme.desc: 2016 Romance with Emilie Ullerup. A doctor planning a surprise Christmas party clashes with the hospital's new CFO, who is determined to trim the budget instead of the tree - until Cupid scrubs in.

programme.title: Holiday Hotline
programme.desc: 2023 Phone-omenal romance with Emily Tennant. There's love on the line when a woman working at a switchboard connects with a charming anonymous caller - but she doesn't realise they've already met.

programme.title: A Song For Christmas
programme.desc: Single parents Jennifer and Nate's blossoming relationship is threatened.

programme.title: Candy Cane Christmas
programme.desc: 2020 Christmas romance with Beverley Mitchell. When her favourite tradition of decorating Candy Cane Lane is cancelled, can Phoebe find something - or someone - new to lift her Christmas spirits?

programme.title: Cross Country Christmas
programme.desc: 2020 Romcom with Rachael Leigh Cook and Greyston Holt. When a snowstorm grounds planes and halts trains, can two old friends make it ho-ho-home for Christmas - no matter the mode of transport?

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Christmas
programme.desc: 2017 Romance starring Lindy Booth. After a messy public break-up, a woman retreats to her uncle's ranch - where a run-in with a Hollywood actor sparks an unexpected connection.

programme.title: The Christmas Contest
programme.desc: 2021 Festive rivalry starring Candace Cameron Bure and John Brotherton. Exes Lara and Ben compete in a charity Christmas contest, but will they be too wrapped up in winning to notice true love?

programme.title: The Christmas Pageant
programme.desc: 2011 Festive romance starring Melissa Gilbert. A temperamental director is forced to direct a Christmas pageant. She finds herself swept up by the magic of Christmas, and an ex-lover.

programme.title: The Christmas CEO
programme.desc: 2021 Yuletide romcom with Marisol Nichols. Play becomes serious business when a toy company CEO gets an offer to merge with a mega toy firm. But is her ex-business partner ready to seal the deal?

programme.title: Charming Christmas
programme.desc: 2015 Holiday romance with Julie Benz. An uptight woman agrees to play Mrs Claus at her family's department store, and finds herself becoming merrier working alongside a charming man playing Santa.

programme.title: Miss Christmas
programme.desc: 2017 Warming romance with Brooke D'Orsay. A Christmas enthusiast puts out a desperate plea to find the perfect tree for her town square - but the tree isn't all she'll be gifted with this season.

programme.title: A Blue Ridge Mountain Christmas
programme.desc: Willow returns to her hometown to help with her sister's Christmas wedding. But will her life change forever when she meets the new owner of her family's former inn? Rachael Leigh Cook stars. 2019

programme.title: Christmas Wishes and Mistletoe Kisses
programme.desc: 2019 Seasonal romance with Jill Wagner. A wealthy businessman hires an interior designer to add some festive spirit to his home, and soon finds his life touched by her cheerful presence.

programme.title: A Christmas Village
programme.desc: 2018 Yuletide drama with Madeline Leon. When a disgraced PR expert tries to rebuild her reputation by helping a failing Christmas village, she discovers she has a lot to learn about life - and love.

programme.title: Christmas Comes Home
programme.desc: A widower falls for his son's physical rehabilitation specialist.

programme.title: There's a Noose Waiting for You Trinity!
programme.desc: Trinity is an ex-gunslinger desperately wanting to be forgiven and accepted by his family that he abandoned years earlier. Unfortunately for him, a ruthless bounty hunter is on his trail.

programme.title: Raise Your Hands, Dead Man, You're Under Arrest
programme.desc: The sole survivor, named Sando Kid (Peter Lee Lawrence), of a massacre in the North seeks revenge. After suffering the atrocity, the Kid executes a solo revenge, razes, beats and kills everyone involved in the massacre.

programme.title: Renegade Gunfighter
programme.desc: After witnessing his parents’ murder by a ruthless gang, a young man dedicates his life to becoming the fastest gun in the West. Years later, he returns to his hometown, armed with deadly skill and a thirst for vengeance, determined to face the killers who destroyed his family and reclaim his peace.

programme.title: Murieta!
programme.desc: The story of Joaquin Murrieta, a real life Mexican bandit who terrorized California with his gang of raiders and cutthroats during the first half of the 19th century. Some saw him as a murderous outlaw, others as the Mexican Robin Hood.

programme.title: Trusting Is Good... Shooting Is Better
programme.desc: Three bandits steal $200,000, but betrayal leaves the loot buried with a dying man. Glenn Hilton pursues the money, while the surviving thieves, a scheming banker, and the alluring Liz all try to claim a share. Greed, deceit, and double-crosses spark a chaotic hunt for the cash.

programme.title: Brother Outlaw
programme.desc: A man is falsely charged with bank robbery, prompting his brother to break him out of prison.

programme.title: Twice a Judas
programme.desc: After waking up with amnesia in the desert next to a dead man, Luke Barrett begins piecing together his past. A stranger in black reveals that Luke was hired to kill his own brother, Victor Barrett, a wealthy landowner. As Luke seeks the truth, a deadly confrontation looms, and his memory recovery brings both clarity and danger.

programme.title: The Desperado Trail
programme.desc: After the Civil War, renegade Rollins and his gang stir conflict between settlers and Native Americans. Apache chief Winnetou and his friend Old Shatterhand try to preserve peace, but Winnetou is framed for the murder of Chief White Buffalo’s son using his own knife. Old Shatterhand must uncover the truth and clear his friend’s name.

programme.title: California
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Michael "California" Random, is released from prison and goes to Missouri with his partner William.

programme.title: Apache Gold
programme.desc: The construction of the Great Western Railroad causes tension between settlers and Native American tribes. Criminal gang leader Santer seeks control of a gold mine on sacred Apache land and manipulates the railroad route through it. Old Shatterhand, working as a surveyor, uncovers the scheme and tries to warn the Apaches to prevent war.

programme.title: Trinity and Sartana Are Coming
programme.desc: Sartana and Trinity set out on a grudging relationship hell bent for gold and comic brawls.

programme.title: The Cold Killer
programme.desc: José Desman kills his employer, former judge Salazar, who had sentenced his father. This story explores revenge and personal justice as the son confronts the man responsible for his family’s tragedy.

programme.title: Companeros!
programme.desc: A Swedish arms dealer and a Mexican peon team up to rescue the intellectual leader of the Revolutionary cause, while taking part in numerous misadventures along the way.

programme.title: Black Tigress
programme.desc: Lola, a saloon dancer, arrives in Sant'Anna, a town terrorized by outlaw El Diablo, who aims to sell the land to a railroad. With the help of Rod, a young admirer, Lola inspires the townspeople to rise up and fight for their land.

programme.title: Where the Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Young adventurer Gipo owns a fifth of a rock marking a gold mine. With the help of the alluring Lulu Belle, he braves deadly dangers to recover the missing pieces and claim the treasure, facing treachery and peril along the way.

programme.title: Cjamango
programme.desc: Just when Cjamango has won a bag of gold in a poker game, he is attacked by the gangs of El Tigre and Don Pablo.

programme.title: Degueyo
programme.desc: When Ramon's bandits storm Danger City for rumored treasure, they slaughter or capture the men, leaving only women and children to face a ruthless "Deguello" if the money isn’t found. Four determined men, already hunting Ramon, join forces to help the town defend itself.

programme.title: Four Came to Kill Sartana
programme.desc: When bandits begin kidnapping Clayton City’s elite for ransom, Sartana is called in to restore order. But the gang’s mysterious leader sees him as a deadly threat and hires four expert killers to take him down. To save the town and expose the mastermind, Sartana must survive every trap and betrayal.

programme.title: Two Brothers in Trinity
programme.desc: After inheriting a land plot in a dusty place called Trinity, the antagonistic half-brothers, Lester and Jesse, reunite to pursue different aspirations, only to find themselves neck-deep in trouble. Will they ever fulfil their dreams?

programme.title: A Few Bullets More
programme.desc: Billy starts as an innocent outlaw protecting his mother but soon becomes a ruthless killer. When love gives him hope for change, Pat Garrett, a fatherly friend, helps him try to turn his life around. Yet fate drags Billy back into violence, and Garrett is ultimately credited with his death.

programme.title: A Town Called Hell
programme.desc: A group of Mexican revolutionaries murders a town priest and a number of his christian followers. Ten years later, a widow arrives in town intent to take revenge from her husband's killers.

programme.title: You're Jinxed, Friend You've Met Sacramento
programme.desc: This fast-moving tale revolves around the kidnaping of a boxer's daughter. The boxer pays the ransom money but the girl is still not released. Her boyfriend decides to get her back his own way, killing her ruthless captor in a fierce duel.

programme.title: $1,000 on the Black
programme.desc: Twelve years ago, Sartana framed his brother Johnny for murder and stole his girlfriend. Now the town's undisputed boss and doted over by his possessive mother, Sartana seems safe - until, his sentence served, Johnny rides back into town.

programme.title: And God Said to Cain
programme.desc: After ten years in prison for a crime he didn’t commit, ex-Confederate officer Gary Hamilton returns to seek revenge on Acombar, the man who framed him and stole both his gold and his lover. Surrounded by enemies, Hamilton uses the town’s secret tunnels to strike back in a stormy, haunting showdown.

programme.title: Taste of Killing
programme.desc: Dubious Bounty Killer Hank Fellows tracks bank stage coaches to observe them being robbed.

programme.title: Cry Blood Apache
programme.desc: Gang of sadistic cowboys let nothing stand in their way in their search for gold.

programme.title: Two Faces of the Dollar
programme.desc: A teacher, a hero, an ex-colonel, and a beautiful woman plan to rob Fort Henderson. Though the heist succeeds, their troubles have only just begun, as greed, betrayal, and danger threaten to unravel their carefully laid plan.

programme.title: Against a Crooked Sky
programme.desc: The eldest daughter of a pioneer family is kidnapped by a mysterious Indian tribe and the eldest son pursues. In order to win back his sister's freedom, he must sacrifice his own life by passing the test of "Crooked Sky" and shield his sister from an executioner's arrow. Along the way, he recruits a broken down, drunk prospector to help him track down the unknown tribe and rescue his sister.

programme.title: iCarly: Das Nerd-Camp
programme.desc: Als Gibby einen Plan ausheckt, um Sam und Freddie zu trennen, deckt Mrs. Benson deren Beziehung auf. Wird sich Carly für Sam und Freddie einsetzen oder Gibby dabei helfen, sie auseinander zu bringen?

programme.title: iCarly: Zu dumm
programme.desc: Carly will ihren neuen Schwarm damit beeindrucken, indem sie sich schlauer gibt als sie eigentlich ist. Währenddessen hilft der Rest der Truppe T-Bo dabei, ein neues zu Hause zu finden, weil er aus dem 'Groovy Smoothie' geschmissen wurde.

programme.title: iCarly: Besuch der First Lady
programme.desc: Die Kids wollen Carlys Vater eine Online-Geburtstagsparty schmeißen. Doch als sie sich in ein gesichertes Netzwerk einhacken, bekommen sie Ärger von einer wichtigen Informationsagentur des Landes.

programme.title: iCarly: Psycho-Nora kehrt zurück – Teil 1
programme.desc: Die iCarly-Kids erfahren, dass Nora Dershlit aus dem Knast freikommen soll. Was können sie tun, damit ihre ehemalige Peinigerin hinter Gittern bleibt?

programme.title: iCarly: Psycho-Nora kehrt zurück – Teil 2
programme.desc: Die iCarly-Gang muss einen Weg finden, vor Nora und ihren verrückten Eltern zu fliehen.

programme.title: iCarly: Im Butterkuchen-Himmel
programme.desc: Alle außer Carly gehen zur Kanadischen Kuchenfabrik, doch Sam darf nicht wieder in die USA einreisen. Unterdessen macht sich Carly ausgehfertig für ein Date.

programme.title: iCarly: Oh weh, 3D!
programme.desc: Freddie will seine kreative Seite spielen lassen und entscheidet sich iCarly in 3D zu senden. Spencer stellt einen Assistenten an, den er nicht bezahlen kann.

programme.title: iCarly: Pleiten, Pech und noch mehr Patzer
programme.sub-title: Pleiten, Pech und noch mehr Patzer
programme.desc: Christopher Cane, der bei 'Victorious' den Charakter 'Rex' spielt, interviewt die Stars von iCarly und zeigt die besten Outtakes der Staffel.

programme.title: iCarly: Action mit One Direction
programme.desc: Nach einem Urlaub hat sich Carly eine ansteckende Krankheit eingefangen. Leider steckt sie ein Mitglied der Band One Direction an. Spencer soll mit einem kleinen Mädchen trainieren, das keine Lust hat Sport zu treiben.

programme.title: iCarly: Gibbys Traum
programme.desc: Mithilfe von Sam eröffnet Gibby im Keller der Schule ein geheimes Restaurant. Unterdessen designt Spencer einen Sicherheitsroboter fürs Loft. Doch der Roboter spielt plötzlich verrückt!

programme.title: iCarly: April, April ...
programme.desc: Es ist der 1. April! Carly und Spencer sollen aus ihrer Wohnung zwangsgeräumt werden, also teilen die Freunde ihre gemeinsamen Erlebnisse in der Wohnung. Doch wir erinnern uns etwas anders.

programme.title: iCarly: Plötzlich Verkäuferin
programme.desc: Freddies neuer Traumjob im Pear Store wird zum Albtraum sobald Sam auch angeheuert wird. Unterdessen will Carly, dass einer ihrer Kollegen sie nach einem Date fragt und Spencer muss bei der Freiwilligen Feuerwehr ehrenamtlich arbeiten.

programme.title: iCarly: Happy Hälft-o-ween!
programme.desc: Die iCarly-Gang schmeißt eine 'Hälft-o-ween' Party, weil Halloween so toll ist, dass es am besten zweimal im Jahr gefeiert werden sollte! Doch die Party gerät außer Kontrolle als ein kostümierter Gast Carly und ihren Freunden einen Streich spielt.

programme.title: iCarly: Chip, Chuck & Spencer
programme.desc: Gibbys neues Spielzeug geht kaputt, doch Freddie repariert es ihm und legt noch einen oben drauf. Spencer versucht einem rachsüchtigen Kind mit allen Mitteln das Handwerk zu legen.

programme.title: iCarly: Hausverbot
programme.desc: Carly verbietet T-Bo einen Fuß in die Wohnung zu setzen. Er revanchiert sich, indem er sie aus dem Groovy Smoothie verbannt. Freddie und Gibby entdecken die Vorzüge einer Band anzugehören. Doch Pflichten bringt es auch mit sich.

programme.title: iCarly: Ausflug nach Vegas
programme.desc: Als Sam erfährt, dass ihre Mutter in Las Vegas im Gefängnis sitzt, packt die Truppe ihre wertvollsten Sachen ein und verpfändet sie, um Geld für die Kaution aufzutreiben. Gastdarsteller: die Besetzung der History-Channel-Serie 'Die Drei vom Pfandhaus'.

programme.title: iCarly: Brave Mädchen, böse Mädchen
programme.desc: Sams Freundin wird aus dem Jugendgefängnis entlassen, und Sam rät allen, sich von ihr fernzuhalten. Doch Carly hört nicht auf sie und traut sich zu viel zu. Im Loft findet Spencer eine Nachtsichtbrille.

programme.title: iCarly: Gibby schockiert Amerika – Teil 1
programme.desc: Talkshow-Legende Jimmy Fallon lädt die Crew von iCarly ein, live in seiner Show in New York zu performen. Doch live auf Sendung schockiert Gibby durch ein Hosen-Missgeschick die ganze Welt und bringt beide Shows in große Schwierigkeiten.

programme.title: iCarly: Gibby schockiert Amerika – Teil 2
programme.desc: Talkshow-Legende Jimmy Fallon lädt die Crew von iCarly ein, live in seiner Show in New York zu performen. Doch live auf Sendung schockiert Gibby durch ein Hosen-Missgeschick die ganze Welt und bringt beide Shows in große Schwierigkeiten.

programme.title: iCarly: Freunde für Spencer
programme.desc: Die Truppe zieht los, um für Spencer Freunde in seinem Alter zu suchen. Sie finden schließlich ein paar vielversprechende Kandidaten. Aber werden sie auch wirklich zu Freunden?

programme.title: iCarly: Ciao Carly – Teil 1
programme.desc: Als Spencer an einem für Carly wichtigen Abend Fieber bekommt, versucht er, seine Krankheit vor ihr zu verstecken. Sam restauriert ein Motorrad, und Freddie bekommt ein peinliches neues Handy.

programme.title: iCarly: Ciao Carly – Teil 2
programme.desc: Carly hat sich gerade damit abgefunden, dass sie nicht zum Ball gehen wird, als ihr Vater plötzlich auftaucht, um mit ihr hinzugehen. Carlys Abend nimmt eine weitere unerwartete Wendung, als ihr Vater ihr eine lebensverändernde Frage stellt.

programme.title: iCarly: Miss Briggs sagt 'No!'
programme.desc: Mitgefangen, mitgehangen: Carly muss ausbaden, dass sich ihre beste Freundin und Banknachbarin Sam in der Schule mal wieder einen Streich erlaubt hat.

programme.title: iCarly: Eine leuchtende Idee
programme.desc: Carly hat die Idee, einen Wettstreit zu veranstalten und die Zuschauer online über den Sieger abstimmen zu lassen. Es geht darum, welches Team die beste Idee hat, wie man mehr Zuschauer für iCarly gewinnen kann.

programme.title: iCarly: Ein Schotte kommt selten allein
programme.desc: Carly und Co. fordern ihre treue Fangemeinde auf, ihre eigenen Tanz-Videoclips aufzunehmen und einzusenden. Die Reaktion ist überwältigend: In kürzester Zeit trudeln über 3.000 Videos ein – die natürlich alle gesichtet werden müssen.

programme.title: iCarly: Ein liebes Lied
programme.desc: Carly hat sich in einen Jungen aus der Schule verliebt. Weil sie ihn mag, lädt sie ihn dazu ein, in ihrer Webshow zu singen und Gitarre zu spielen. Leider merkt sie zu spät, welch ein schlechter Sänger Jake wirklich ist.

programme.title: iCarly: Das Großvaterdebakel
programme.desc: Carly und Spencer bekommen überraschend Besuch von ihrem Großvater. Er ist sehr besorgt darüber, dass Spencer nicht verantwortungsbewusst genug ist, um sich weiter um Carly zu kümmern. Carly und ihre Freunde versuchen das Gegenteil zu beweisen.

programme.title: iCarly: Nevel Supernerd
programme.desc: Carly und Co. bemühen sich darum, eine positive Kritik bei Nevelocity zu bekommen, einer Webseite, die über fünf Millionen Besucher pro Tag zu verzeichnet. Als sich Carly mit Nevel trifft, findet sie heraus, was für ein nerviger Junge er ist.

programme.title: iCarly: Absolut halloweenös!
programme.desc: Carly und Co. nehmen eine Show in einem alten Apartment auf, in dem es angeblich spukt. Als merkwürdige Dinge passieren, befürchten die Freunde, dass die Behauptungen über die Geisterwohnung wahr sein könnten.

programme.title: iCarly: Miss Briggs privat
programme.desc: Carly & Co. betätigen sich als Spione: Sie wollen herausfinden, was ihre Lehrer so in ihrer Freizeit tun - und die nichts ahnenden Pädagogen werden dabei für die iCarly-Website gefilmt!

programme.desc: Master Wu mistakenly tries to single-handedly complete a battle he began decades ago against Acronix, one of the twin Hands of Time.

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
programme.desc: In the midst of an epidemic of mysterious metal thefts by the Vermillion Warriors, Lloyd realizes that stepping up and taking over for the ailing Master Wu is not an easy task.

programme.desc: Secrets are revealed as Nya confronts the Samurai X imposter, Kai pursues the truth about his parents and the other Ninja desperately seek to locate and rescue Master Wu. But as usual, some answers only lead to more questions.

programme.title: Pakistan Tonight
programme.desc: Pakistan Tonight with Adil Nizami is a show well known for covering events as they happen.

programme.title: Stick Up
programme.desc: The story about two friends from high school who try to turn two women from nothing into something by making them sell drugs and prostitute. Things go wrong after they find out what they are getting themselves into. But it’s up to Tierney to try to save her friend from destruction!

programme.title: She Thought
programme.desc: Markisha is a sexy bombshell that uses her body to get whatever man she thinks would spoil her with love & money, even if it means betraying her own family. Markisha soon realizes that the grass isn’t as green on the other side.

programme.title: Revisiting the Heart
programme.desc: Azia Steed is a lead homicide detective who handles a heavy caseload while juggling her personal life. After taking some time off, she runs into an old fling, Dr. Ezrah Jacobs III. Azia receives a case involving the murder of a known local basketball star. The more evidence is uncovered, the stronger the web of deception becomes.

programme.title: Killer Baby Daddy
programme.desc: Ciera and her baby daddy Byron are not getting along after she catches him on the phone with another woman. Ciera tries to make the relationship work but Byron doesn't want to change his ways. Ciera decides to call it quits with Byron. While jogging in the park one day, Ciera runs into her high school sweetheart, Curtis. When Byron finds out about Ciera’s new man, he begins to destroy everything in her life. Ciera must protect her baby and her life before Byron kills everyone she loves.

programme.title: Ebony Hustle 2: Ballistic Protection
programme.desc: Local detective and icon Ebony Hustle returns to help the community and solve cases. This time around she meets local up-and-coming basketball star Mac Pendleton and begins to kindle a romance with him. The two seem to be going strong, till one day Mac starts to become unruly and angry. All the while she encounters an old rival and seeks to make amends and start fresh, to much difficulty. Will Ebony be able to save her new relationship, as well as heal old wounds and continue to thrive?

programme.title: Flew'd Out
programme.desc: Tiara is an up and coming social media influencer after going viral for posting a mans reaction online after denying him sex. In an attempt to grow her online profile, she accepts a date from a man named Josiah for an out of town excursion. Over time, Josiah's intentions become more elaborate, deranged, and sinister. Will Tiara make it out alive?

programme.title: Have You Seen My Man?
programme.desc: After a long night of partying, Niecey's man Chase is nowhere to be found. Just when things couldn’t get any worse, here comes the exes and their drama. The tables turn and the finger pointing begins, Niecy knows there's no turning back now, she has to find the truth and her man.

programme.title: The Sermon
programme.desc: When a charismatic pastor’s sermons begin to influence a group of men searching for purpose, their actions evolve into a series of calculated crimes carried out in the name of righteousness.

programme.title: Hated By Many Loved By None
programme.desc: After a violent robbery and a shocking betrayal from her incarcerated husband, Jahzara is forced to fend for herself in a world she was never meant to lead. With her closest friends, Tomeka and Honey, by her side, she steps into the drug game, determined to rebuild her life. But as money, power, and new connections take over, loyalty quickly turns into betrayal.

programme.title: Why Not You
programme.desc: Young executive Quincy Jackson finds himself at odds with his current girlfriend, when he discovers his coworker Joi is in a similar situation of her own. As they bond over their relationship troubles, their fates become intertwined.

programme.title: Brick Nash
programme.desc: Brick Nash returns home after several years following his father’s mysterious death, hoping to solve the mystery of his death. What begins as a search for answers quickly pulls him into a dangerous world of hidden money, violent criminals, and powerful people with secrets they’ll do anything to protect.

programme.title: The Saved and the Salacious

programme.desc: A baby turtle grows into a gigantic beast that saves Tokyo from a monstrous lizard.

programme.title: Quantum Voyage
programme.desc: Mattie Carver experiences auditory and visual hallucinations as she witnesses the collapse of space and time.

programme.title: The Brain That Wouldn't Die
programme.desc: A surgeon (Jason Evers) tapes his fiancée's (Virginia Leith) mouth shut and prepares to put her head on a model's (Adele Lamont) body.

programme.title: Burst City
programme.desc: Punk bands protest a nuclear power plant and are attacked by yakuza thugs until a pair of metal-clad bikers arrives.

programme.title: The Final Countdown
programme.desc: A time warp takes the aircraft carrier USS Nimitz and its captain (Kirk Douglas) back to Pearl Harbor, Dec. 6, 1941.

programme.title: In the Moscow Slums
programme.desc: Moscow, 1902. Konstantin Stanislavsky turns to Vladimir Gilyarovsky to search the underworld for inspiration for a new play. Together they find themselves embroiled in the murder of an Indian Sikh.

programme.title: The Golden Fern
programme.desc: A wood cutter finds a golden fern that transforms into a beautiful young woman, but fate conspires to part them.

programme.title: Karmalink
programme.desc: In near-future Phnom Penh, Cambodia, a teen boy and a street-smart girl work to untangle the mystery of the boy's dreams of his past life. However, what begins as a playful treasure hunt leads to the possibility of digital enlightenment.

programme.title: Raining in the Mountain
programme.desc: A general and an esquire employ martial artists to steal a scroll hidden in the monastery's library.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A successful day at the races for the racehorse, Bantling Boy, the previous day, it is not long before one of the horses' owners is found murdered in the horses' stables. The victim, Bruce Hartley, had been in dispute with the other owners of Bantling Boy, the night before his murder had had a rather heated argument with them and had refused to let them acceptance of an offer to buy the horse. It seems to make things a whole lot worse of the others in the syndicate.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: John Ransom gets thrown out of the village pub in Midsomer Mere, for fighting with his brother-in-law, and a short while later he is found dead on the green. It is discovered that John had been used as a guinea pig for scientific experiments by his brother Max, who suspected he had the ability of 'Second Sight'. Barnaby and Scott soon discover that another family possesses the same talent. They have to delve deeper to unravel many secrets within the village to find the truth.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When solicitor Nick Turner apparently commits suicide by walking off the roof of his home in Midsomer Magna, then Nick's neighbour Jack Wilmot mysteriously disappears that same day, it starts a series of unexplained events. Barnaby and Scott soon discover that a large amount of money has gone missing from the account of one of Nick's clients. Shortly afterwards, Nick's rival gets murdered in an elaborate ritual, by his own model of a medieval catapult, while his wife is forced to watch.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The body of a visitor is found on-site at the famous relish factory of Plummer & Son in the village of Little Upton. When the detectives begin investigating the Plummer family and its staff, it turns out that the victim, Dexter Lockwood, was known to the family and had been on a guided tour of the factory the day before his body was found. It is not long before legal documents, family resentments and mysterious sightings add to the complexity of the case.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Retired music teacher Arthur Leggott is murdered after disturbing an intruder at his home in Badger's Drift. It is discovered that a musical manuscript by the late composer Joan Alder has since gone missing before being sent to auction. When the manuscript shows signs that it has been written by another hand, a handwritten letter by Joan Alder turns up indicating the manuscript is a forgery. Where the manuscript goes more murders follow.

programme.title: Super Sleuths - Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: This special documentary examines Inspector Barnaby - his methods and techniques of investigation, from his time in the original novels through his translation to television.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The villagers of Fletcher's Cross are preparing for their team match against Midsomer Worthy. Tara Cavendish, the second wife of local landowner and cricket captain Robert Cavendish, has since gone missing after taking their dog for a walk. When her body is later discovered nearby in a disused quarry, with the weapon, a cricket bat lying, next to her.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Alice Bly arrives at Lawnside, a nursing home in Aspern Tallow to rest after having hospital treatment. She soon suspects something is not right when a fellow resident dies the night after her arrival. It is also discovered that the lady's valuable Cartier watch has also gone missing. Alice's nephew DCI Barnaby agrees to look into things despite having a week's leave. It is not long before two more deaths quickly follow the first and a mysterious visitor is seen lurking around at night.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The residents of Midsomer Mallow are preparing for the 'Perfect English Village' competition even though a few days earlier saw the murder of local thief and lothario, Peter Drinkwater (Orlando Bloom). Barnaby and Troy discover that he had been stabbed with a pitchfork while squatting at an abandoned farm. The detectives must deduce if one of his burglary victims, his accomplice in the robberies or another disgruntled villager may have been the killer.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Shortly before his retirement, Superintendent Pringle arrests a local poacher for the murder of a tramp during a fox hunt in woodland close to the village of Upper Marshwood. DCI Barnaby is unsure that the poacher was the killer. Upon returning from holidaying in France, Barnaby is proved right, when the poacher's father is murdered with his own shotgun. As they reopen the investigation, they find many hidden secrets amongst the villagers.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When the body of a local beauty is discovered by the pool at her manor house, Barnaby and Troy uncover a seedy world of adultery and deceit within the affluent rural community.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Someone is killing off parish church bell ringers in the week before a big bell-ringing competition takes place in the village of Midsomer Mallow.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby investigates the murder of a boy during a traditional annual race at an exclusive private school but meets with resentment.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: An investigation of a car fire and a bludgeon murder lead Barnaby and Troy to investigate the members of a local reading club which has an agenda that goes beyond books.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A woman is found dead in Setwale Wood, an apparent suicide, except that her suicide note is emailed after her body has already been sighted.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Peter and Caroline Cave are house-hunting in Midsomer Newton, when they hear about a house called Winyard; a tumbledown cottage in the woods. At the estate agents they get informed "that the house is not yet available for viewing". They view the house a short time later by themselves anyway. The following morning they are both found dead in their car, near the house. DCI Barnaby and Acting DC Ben Jones enter a world of property developers, eccentric villagers, estate agents and ghost stories.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Midsomer Barton, the villagers are all celebrating the annual Oak Apple Week. After the body of a woman is found in a stream, the return of the carnival queen event, after a hiatus of eight years, is speculated to be the reason for a series of murders. With recognisable faces from the past, drunken boasts, hidden obsessions and secret loves, Barnaby and Jones try to restore peace and harmony to the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The wealthy, eccentric and obese Sir Freddy Butler drops dead, shortly after gathering all three of his wives to Haddington Hall to make an announcement. George Bullard tells Barnaby that the death was from natural causes. The case gets more complex when Freddy's solicitor is deliberately killed in an arson attack on his home and Freddy's will goes missing.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Midsomer Worthy, council clerk Martin Barrett is shot to death through his kitchen window, while a mystery woman settles in, in the spare room upstairs. Barnaby and Jones discover Barrett was a skillful blackmailer, and believe his murderer to be one of his victims. The investigation takes Barnaby and Joyce to the seaside at Fennacombe Bay and Jones to question Sir John Waverley.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A 90-year-old feud between the male and female inhabitants of Broughton once again comes to a head with an event known as the Skimmington Ride. When elderly Ms Danvers is poisoned a short time before the event takes place. Barnaby and Jones have to investigate whether it was to do with the feud, a long held buried secret, or something else. This looks more likely when the Rev. Anthony Gant is shot and killed whilst taking part in the traditional ride. Before another villager ends up dead.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Villagers of Eleverton-cum-Latterly are divided over the building of a new supermarket development. Shortly after a heated meeting, Frank Hopkirk, an independent environmental supervisor is found stabbed at Jubb's timber yard, the site of the new supermarket, by a pair of children. When Barnaby and Jones investigate they find he came to the village for secret rendezvous with various female villagers in fantasy role-playing scenarios.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Midsomer Worthy is gearing up for the Four Choirs Competition, when one of their members, Connor Simpson, is found dead at his home. Barnaby and Jones begin to look into the events leading to his death. The case is further complicated, when a birdwatcher and estate keeper is also killed. After it is found he had been photographing suspicious activity, an attempted murder is interrupted.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Around a year ago, Annie Woodrow was arrested and accused of the murder of her best friend, Frances Trevelyan, on the motive of fondness for Frances's husband. As Annie's trial begins, DCI Barnaby is uncertain of her guilt. A chance remark by Frances's youngest daughter and meeting with an old friend in psychiatry, makes him reevaluate the evidence for her conviction.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Deep in Blacktrees Forest is a bombproof shelter, at which a doomsday prepper group meets weekly.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby is called in when a new arrival to a tight-knit community for retired police officers is found dead.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A trendy organic bakery in a restored mill is at the centre of a local dispute which leads to a death.

programme.title: Barbie v Luskáčikovi
programme.desc: Barbie tentoraz vďaka neprekonateľnej počítačovej animácii ožije v tejto prekrásnej modernej verzii klasickej rozprávky E. T. A. Hoffmanna v naozaj úžasnéj forme. Rozprávka začína tým, že Barbie, ktorá hrá úlohu Kláry, dostane od svojej najmilšie tety krásnu drevenú bábku - je to luskáčik na orechy - avšak Luskáčik sa ešte tej istej noci, zatiaľ čo Klára spí, stane živým princom, aby dievča ochránil pred zlým Myším kráľom, ktorý prenikol ku Kláre do izby. Dievčatko sa prebudí a Luskáčikovi pomôže, ale Myší kráľ zlým čarom Kláru zmenší. Preto sa musí s Luskáčikom vydať na dobrodružnú cestu, aby našli kňažnú Bonbón, jedine ona totiž dokáže zlomiť zlé čiary myšieho kráľa. Krásu príbehu umocňujú strhujúce tanečné scény, ktoré na príjemnú Čajkovského hudbu vymyslel a nacvičil slávny choreograf Peter Martins. Skutočné pohyby členov Newyorským mestského baletu predvádzajú krásu baletu na televíznej obrazovke spôsobom, ktorý bol doteraz nepredstaviteľný. Barbie v Luskáčikovi divákom...

programme.title: Barbie Mariposa a Kvetinová princezná
programme.desc: Vydajte sa spoločne s Barbie ™ do úplne nového sveta, v ktorom vládnu motýlie víly! Mariposa ™ je krásna motýlia víla, ktorá rada číta a sníva o svete, ktorý leží za bránami jej domova v krajine Flutterfield ™. Bezpečie Flutterfielda ™ strážia kráľovnej čarovné poblikávajúce svetielka. Potom ale kráľovnú otrávi zlá víla Henna a svetlá jedno po druhom zhasínajú. A tak musí statočná Mariposa ™ a jej priatelia vyraziť na cestu za hranice bezpečného mesta, aby spoločne našli protilátku, ktorá by kráľovnú zachránila. Pridajte sa k motýlím vílam na ich vzrušujúcom dobrodružstve, ktoré všetky raz navždy zmení!

programme.title: Barbie: Tajomstvo víl
programme.desc: Jedného krásneho dňa príde Barbie na to, že víly skutočne existujú. Celé to začne tým, že Ken znenazdajky zmizne. Dve módne návrhárky, ktoré sa s Barbie priatelia, jej prezradia, že sú vlastne víly a Ken sa práve nachádza v kúzelnom vílom svete. Barbie a jej rivalka Raquelle sa vydajú na dobrodružnú cestu, aby Kena priviedli späť. Celú svoju púť musia absolvovať spolu, a tak majú dosť príležitostí, aby si uvedomili, že pravé kúzlo sa neskrýva v ríši víl, ale v sile priateľstva.

programme.title: Barbie - Dobrodružstvo princeznej
programme.desc: Spievajte spoločne s Barbie v úplne novom muzikáli Dobrodružstvo princeznej Barbie. Dobrodružstvo začína, keď Barbie s kamarátkami cestujú do krajiny Floravia, aby sa stretli s princeznou Ameliou, ktorá sa Barbie dosť podobá. Princezná Amelia je nervózna z toho, že sa má stať kráľovnou, tak príde s plánom vymeniť si miesto s Barbie. Ich tajomstvo je v bezpečí, kým rivalský princ neodhalí pravdu. Potom už záleží len na Barbie a jej kamarátkach, aby princa zastavili a princeznú vyslobodili včas pred korunováciou. S pomocou kamarátok Barbie pomôže Amelie objaviť silu vo vlastnom hlase. Táto vzrušujúca muzikálová oslava, plná zábavných pesničiek a nových priateľov, ukazuje, že najlepšie je byť sám sebou.

programme.title: Barbie a dvanásť tancujúcich princezien
programme.desc: Kde bolo tam bolo, hudba plnila zámok kde žilo nie jedna, nie dve, ale dvanásť princezien so svojím milovaným ockom, kráľom. Od najstarších po najmladších, všetkých dvanásť princezien milovalo tanec. Najpôvabnejšou tanečnicou zo všetkých bola siedma princezná, Barbie. Kráľ, premožený výchovou dvanástich energických dcér požiadal o pomoc svoju sesternicu, Rowenu. Chamtivá Rowena rýchlo vyženie radosť z hradu v prestrojení za snahu vychovať z princezien "dokonalé princezné". Už žiadny tanec. Žiadna hudba. Žiadna zábava. Princezné sú z toho nešťastné, až do doby kedy sa Barbie podarí objaviť tajný vchod do magického sveta cez portál v ich spálni. Princezné v ňom nájdu krásny pavilón v krajine zlatých a strieborných stromov. Čarovný prach zo stromov premení ich nočné košele v baletné šaty. V tomto svete môžu konečne princezné robiť to čo najviac milujú... tancovať. Vracajú sa na toto miesto každú noc, tancujúce až do chvíle kedy pretancujú svoje črievice. Každú noc sú znovu a znovu...

programme.title: Zvedavý George - Halloweenske slávnosti
programme.desc: Halloween je takmer tu a George sa nemôže dočkať začiatku oslavy: vyrezávanie tekvíc, súťaže kostýmov a obzvlášť výročného festivalu strašenia. George a Allie, ktorí sa tešia na začiatok slávnosti, navštívia Renkinsovu farmu, aby si vybrali dokonalú tekvicu. Tu budú počuť strašidelnú povesť o No Nogginovi. Podľa povesti je No Noggin strašiak, ktorý sa objavuje na Halloween a skopáva ľuďom klobúky z hlavy. O halloweenskej noci sa George a Allie rozhodnú No Noggina odfotiť a konečne dokázať, že naozaj existuje. Dokážu získať dôkaz? To sa dozvedia len tí zvedaví!

programme.title: Barbie v Luskáčikovi
programme.desc: Barbie tentoraz vďaka neprekonateľnej počítačovej animácii ožije v tejto prekrásnej modernej verzii klasickej rozprávky E. T. A. Hoffmanna v naozaj úžasnéj forme. Rozprávka začína tým, že Barbie, ktorá hrá úlohu Kláry, dostane od svojej najmilšie tety krásnu drevenú bábku - je to luskáčik na orechy - avšak Luskáčik sa ešte tej istej noci, zatiaľ čo Klára spí, stane živým princom, aby dievča ochránil pred zlým Myším kráľom, ktorý prenikol ku Kláre do izby. Dievčatko sa prebudí a Luskáčikovi pomôže, ale Myší kráľ zlým čarom Kláru zmenší. Preto sa musí s Luskáčikom vydať na dobrodružnú cestu, aby našli kňažnú Bonbón, jedine ona totiž dokáže zlomiť zlé čiary myšieho kráľa. Krásu príbehu umocňujú strhujúce tanečné scény, ktoré na príjemnú Čajkovského hudbu vymyslel a nacvičil slávny choreograf Peter Martins. Skutočné pohyby členov Newyorským mestského baletu predvádzajú krásu baletu na televíznej obrazovke spôsobom, ktorý bol doteraz nepredstaviteľný. Barbie v Luskáčikovi divákom...

इवनिंग प्राइम
ஈவினிங் ப்ரைம்
ఈవెనింగ్ ప్రైమ్
इव्हनिंग प्राईम
programme.desc: The host presents prime news stories, updates and developments on current affairs and socio-political issues in the region.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता क्षेत्र में प्रमुख समाचार, वर्तमान घटनाक्रम और सामाजिक-राजनीतिक मुद्दों पर जानकारी और घटनाक्रम प्रस्तुत करते हैं।
நடப்பு விவகாரங்கள் மற்றும் சமூக-அரசியல் பிரச்சினைகள் குறித்த முக்கிய செய்திகள், புதுப்பிப்புகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ప్రాంతంలోని ప్రస్తుత వ్యవహారాలు, సామాజిక-రాజకీయ సమస్యలపై ప్రధాన వార్తా కథనాలు,విశేషాలు, పరిణామాలను అందిస్తారు.

Познавательно-сравнительная составляющая о снастях и приманках. Каждый раз, оказываясь на водоеме, ведущие заключают между собой пари или ставят цель провести некий опыт и попробовать ответить на те вопросы, которые волнуют всех рыболовов. Россия

programme.title: Harlequin: A Change of Place
programme.desc: Da den urolige tvilling Dominique beder sin boglige søster Kimberly om at overtage hendes rolle som glamourøs parisisk model i en måned, tøver Kimberly. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Another Woman
programme.desc: Da Lisa vågner op på hospitalet, kan hun ikke huske noget: Hun kan ikke huske, hvem hun er, at hendes mand ønsker at lade sig skilles. Da hendes mand tager hende med hjem, må Lisa lære alting forfra. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Treacherous Beauties

programme.title: Harlequin: Broken Lullaby

programme.title: Harlequin: At the Midnight Hour
programme.desc: Liz, en smuk barnepige, giver nyt liv til Richard Keaton, en enkemand og videnskabsmand, og hans begavede, men fremmedgjorte søn Andy. Liz' liv er i fare, da hun kommer for tæt på sandheden. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: The Awakening
programme.desc: Da en dusørjæger, der er på sporet af en af hendes lejere, overbeviser Sara McAllister om at slå sig sammen med ham, begynder de et eventyr i den farlige verden af international spionage og kærlighed. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: This Matter of Marriage
programme.desc: Arkitekterne Hallie og Donnalee arbejder på et stort byggeprojekt for en excentrisk milliardær, Adam Barr. Hallie, der har ledt efter sin drømmeprins, finder ham pludselig lige ved siden af. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams, the Pet Sematary.

programme.title: Cujo

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Owen, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz of KICK-ASS), a beautiful but peculiar girl who turns out to be a vampire.

programme.title: Ghost World
programme.desc: The story of neo-cool Enid and Rebecca who, faced with graduation from high school take a hard look at the world they wryly observe. When Rebecca focuses her attention on mutual romantic fixation Josh, the girls friendship is forever changed.

programme.title: Hearts Beat Loud

programme.title: School of Rock

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Misfits Gather
programme.desc: Hitler finds his political destiny in post-war Munich. He quickly dominates a fringe party & builds it into the Nazi Party. He recruits infamous men to the cause including Herman Goering & Heinrich Himmler & they plot a coup known as the Beerhall Putsch.

programme.title: Secret War: The SAS Italian Job
programme.desc: In 1945, during the Italian Spring offensive, SOE agent Michael Lees and SAS officer Roy Farran led a raid on German HQs at Villa Rossi and Villa Calvi. Despite orders to cancel, Farran attacked with SAS men and partisans, killing many Germans.

programme.title: Secret War: Hardy Amies and Operation Ratweek
programme.desc: Operation Ratweek’s existence has always been denied. However WMR has now discovered evidence that it existed and was carried out.

programme.title: Secret War: Double Agent Tricycle
programme.desc: Dusan Popov was almost certainly James Bond. Ian Fleming knew all the stories about him. Popov managed to persuade both the Germans and MI6 to keep him in the style of a millionaire businessman while performing a series of missions against the Nazis.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Dutch Collaborator
programme.desc: Anton Adriaan Mussert, initially resisted Hitler’s anti-Semitism despite modeling his NSB party, even welcoming Jewish members. His failed attempt to kidnap Queen Wilhelmina led him into hiding, after which he collaborated in hopes of gaining power.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Nazis Outfought
programme.desc: By 1944, Hitler's image as a victorious leader is crumbling. He faces a bomb plot led by Stauffenberg and Tresckow, intending to kill him and overthrow the regime. Hitler survives the bombing, triggering a brutal reprisal against conspirators.

programme.title: Battle Of Dunkirk
programme.desc: I en kapplöpning med tiden korsade över 800 privata båtar Engelska kanalen för att rädda de förlistade soldaterna från infernot på Dunkerques stränder. Se enskilda veteraners extraordinära hjältemod i ett slag som förändrade andra världskrigets gång.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Host Wil Willis tests the Garand against the Arisaka Type 99, showcasing its impact in WWII and sniper rifles' deadly precision, from Carlos Hathcock to Craig Harrison. Witness the historic rifles that shaped warfare!

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Killer Police
programme.desc: In Ukraine and Lithuania, Nazi invaders were welcomed as liberators. In Lithuania, Antanas Gecas led a militia that executed hundreds of Jews. Ukrainian nationalists participated in pogroms slaughtering 34,000 Jews in two days.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Croatian Collaborator
programme.desc: Croatia grapples with its fascist past through figures like Dinko Sakic, once hailed as a hero but later convicted of war crimes. Leading the notorious Jasenovac camp, Sakic oversaw brutal atrocities against inmates.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Vidkun Quisling

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Today’s infantry demands a weapon combining machine gun firepower with rifle accuracy and mobility.. Host Wil Willis traces this journey through iconic firearms.

programme.title: Valkiria
programme.desc: En plena Segunda Guerra Mundial, un grupo de altos mandos alemanes desarrollan un plan para asesinar a Adolf Hitler, y aprovechar el poder de los mandos militares para acabar con la guerra.

programme.title: El Espejo Distorsionado del Alma
programme.desc: ¿Cómo sobrevivir cuando tu propio hermano, con el entusiasta apoyo de tu hermana, te vende para pagar sus deudas? ¿Cómo seguir adelante cuando todos a tu alrededor te señalan y gritan, y ni siquiera tus propios padres se interesan por ti? ¿Acaso una falsa acusación de intento de asesinato te empujará al borde de la desesperación? Pero ¿será un pequeño relicario con una foto dentro, último recuerdo de un pasado entrañable, suficiente para ayudarte a soportar esta miseria y sobrevivir a tu tormento?

programme.title: Scream 4
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott, ahora autora de un libro de autoayuda, regresa a casa en Woodsboro, última etapa de la gira promocional. Una vez allí, vuelve a encontrarse con el sheriff Dewey y Gale Weathers que se han casado, pero también su regreso traerá consigo una nueva serie de crímenes cometidos por un antiguo enemigo: Ghostface.

programme.title: Mami Nunca Te Haría Daño
programme.desc: Riley no quiere otra cosa sino reconstruir la relación con su madre y su hermana pequeña, que están enclaustradas debido a la enfermedad de su hermana. Pero cuando Riley nota que su hermana puede no estar tan enferma como parece, su madre se da cuenta y no se detendrá ante nada para mantener a sus hijas con ella para siempre.

programme.title: Desafío
programme.desc: Un grupo de amigas adolescentes decide poner en marcha el juego llamado "triple dog", el desafío, basado en unas reglas y pruebas constantes hacia los miembros del grupo. A medida que los desafíos se vuelven más extremos, las cosas se tuercen y lo que empieza siendo un juego divertido y desenfadado acabará por convertirse en una auténtica pesadilla.

programme.title: Sensing Murder

programme.title: Sensing Murder: A Mother's Worst Nightmare

programme.desc: In 1993, devoted father Kevin O'Loughlin came face to face with the dark side of sunny Nelson when he was brutally stabbed to death after a night out on the town.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Without Warning

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Vanishing Point
programme.desc: In 2003, 32-year-old mother of three Sara Neithe vanished from the Hauraki Plains. Neither Sara nor her car have been seen since. Police suspect that Sara has been murdered but without a crime scene, they have been unable to advance the case.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: The Lie of the Land
programme.desc: Sue Nicholson and Deb Webber investigate one of the most complex and intriguing cases ever featured - did Waikato man Jason Dark commit suicide or was he murdered, as his family believes?

programme.title: Sensing Murder: When The Trail Goes Cold
programme.desc: This episodes involves the disappearance of 62-year-old Kaye Stewart, a woman who went missing while on a short walk on June 13th, 2005.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Looking for Justice
programme.desc: This week, for the first time ever, the prime suspect in a murder enquiry has turned to Sensing Murder for help.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Lost for Words
programme.desc: Spirited teenager Jayne Furlong dreamed of becoming a child psychologist - instead, she ended up a prostitute. In 1993, 17 year old Jayne vanished from her patch on Auckland's Karangahape Road.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Psychics Revealed - Special
programme.desc: Behind the scenes with the psychics on the show.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: Described as a brutal execution, 46-year-old grandmother Chattrice Maihi-Carroll was found naked, stabbed to death in her New Zealand home in 2008. There were multiple suspects and everything seemed resolved following the arrest of a neighbour.

programme.title: Szellemekkel suttogó
programme.desc: S01E01 Melinda újdonsült férjével, Jimmel új házukat próbálják befejezni, mikor Melinda találkozik egy katona szellemével. A férfi arra kéri a nőt, hogy vezesse el a családjához, mert szeretné látni újszülött fiát. Kiderül azonban, hogy a katona a vietnami háborúban harcolt, így évtizedek óta halott.

programme.title: Az újonc
programme.desc: S04E01 Három újonc, Nolan, Lucy és Jackson érkezik a kapitányságra, ahol általában szívesen fogadják őket. Ám John Nolan kivétel. A negyvenéves férfi csődbe ment élete után rendőrként próbál magára találni, és ennek sem a rendőrkapitány, sem pedig a kiképzőtisztek nem örülnek. Úgy vélik, hogy Nolan kapuzárási pánikban szenved, és kora miatt alkalmatlan arra, hogy rendőrként szemlélje az utcát. Csakhogy John Nolan agya másképp van huzalozva, és nemcsak gyorsan tanul, de nem ijed meg az extrém megoldásoktól sem. A 4. évad Nolan rendőrtiszt született tehetség, aki mentális képességeivel ugyanolyan hatékonyan oldja meg a legveszélyesebb ügyeket is, mint fiatal, edzett kollégái. Életében újabb sorsfordító pillanathoz érkezett. Ezúttal nemcsak a saját szakmai karrierjét kell egyengetnie, hanem a következő újonc-generációét is, ráadásul magánélete is rendezésre vár.

programme.desc: S01E01 Melinda újdonsült férjével, Jimmel új házukat próbálják befejezni, mikor Melinda találkozik egy katona szellemével. A férfi arra kéri a nőt, hogy vezesse el a családjához, mert szeretné látni újszülött fiát. Kiderül azonban, hogy a katona a vietnami háborúban harcolt, így évtizedek óta halott.

programme.title: Szellemekkel suttogó
programme.desc: S01E02 Melinda egy hatéves kisfiúval találkozik egy vasúti átjárónál, aki édesanyjára vár, ezért nem akar onnan elmozdulni. Kiderül, hogy a gyermek balesetben elhunyt, amikor kocsijuk megállt a vasúti átjáróban. Melindának meg kell találnia a gyermek szüleit, hogy a fiú lelke megbékélhessen.

programme.title: Az újonc
programme.desc: S04E02 Három újonc, Nolan, Lucy és Jackson érkezik a kapitányságra, ahol általában szívesen fogadják őket. Ám John Nolan kivétel. A negyvenéves férfi csődbe ment élete után rendőrként próbál magára találni, és ennek sem a rendőrkapitány, sem pedig a kiképzőtisztek nem örülnek. Úgy vélik, hogy Nolan kapuzárási pánikban szenved, és kora miatt alkalmatlan arra, hogy rendőrként szemlélje az utcát. Csakhogy John Nolan agya másképp van huzalozva, és nemcsak gyorsan tanul, de nem ijed meg az extrém megoldásoktól sem. A 4. évad Nolan rendőrtiszt született tehetség, aki mentális képességeivel ugyanolyan hatékonyan oldja meg a legveszélyesebb ügyeket is, mint fiatal, edzett kollégái. Életében újabb sorsfordító pillanathoz érkezett. Ezúttal nemcsak a saját szakmai karrierjét kell egyengetnie, hanem a következő újonc-generációét is, ráadásul magánélete is rendezésre vár.

programme.title: Monk - Flúgos nyomozó
programme.desc: S05E13 Monk és Natalie felveszik a harcot egy nagyon népszerű zsokéval szemben, miután Natalie sógornője biztos abban, hogy a sportoló a felelős a felesége haláláért. A zsokénak azonban bombabiztos alibije van.

programme.title: Monk - Flúgos nyomozó

programme.title: Magnum
programme.desc: S02E18 Magnumot felbérelik, hogy védje meg a gazdag luxusjachtost, Jeannie Lowryt a nagy tétes pókerjátszma alatt. A játékosok között akad néhány csaló, és kiderül, hoy a tét valójában jóval nagyobb, mint ahogy a zsetonok mutatják. A jacht hamar veszélyzónává válik.

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők
programme.desc: S12E22 A helyszínelők csapata három holttest ügyében nyomoz, amiket néhány háztömbnyire találtak egy kampány vacsora helyszínétől. Miután körvonalazódni látszik a gyilkos személye, egy megrázó felfedezést tesznek.

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők
programme.desc: S14E01 Egy újabb női holttest kerül elő, akit Dante művének, a Pokol 5. körének díszletei között találnak meg. Az áldozat nagy valószínűséggel az egyik egyházi gyülekezetből származik. Russell és Julie tudja, hogy az idejük vészesen fogy, és hamarosan az eltűnt lányok egyike, Morgan vagy Ellie következik a sorozatgyilkos listáján. Ecklie képtelen megbirkózni azzal, hogy a lánya lehet a Pokol következő helyszínének a főszereplője.

programme.title: CSI: New York-i helyszínelők
programme.desc: S06E17 Szent Patrik napján, miközben az egész város zöldbe borulva ünnepel, a csapat két vörösbe öltöztetett hullára bukkan. Nagy titok nyomára bukkannak az aranykészítő művelettel kapcsolatban, ami a két blogger életébe került, és ami halálos lehet Reed barátja számára is, aki látta a bűntényt, és épp leleplezni készül a titkot.
