programme.title: Rishto Ki Dor
रिश्तो की डोर
ரிஷ்தோ கி தோர்
రిష్తో కి డోర్
programme.desc: A collection of stories from people's daily lives, which teaches valuable lessons about being a good human being, is presented.
लोगों के दैनिक जीवन की कहानियों का संग्रह प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जो एक अच्छे इंसान बनने के लिए अच्छे सबक सिखाता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க பாடங்களைக் கற்பிக்கும், மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கையிலிருந்து வரும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு வழங்கப்படுகிறது.
తల్లిదండ్రుల మరణం తరువాత తన ముగ్గురు చెల్లెళ్లను చూసుకోవడానికి చాలా కష్టపడుతున్న సుహాస్ చాలా సవాళ్లను ఎదుర్కొంటాడు.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Missing Map
programme.desc: The Turtles are showing Zach, "the fifth Turtle," and his brother Walt their scrapbook.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Gang's All Here
programme.desc: Michelangelo falls for a Shredder trick and eats a chocolate chip cookie made with anti-mutagen capable of turning him into a human being.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Grybyx
programme.desc: The Neutrinos - Dask, Kala and Zak - are back on Earth in search of Kala's pet Grybyx, a small and cuddly creature that, "mega bizzarro," can turn into a humongous monster.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Mister Ogg Goes to Town
programme.desc: When Krang realizes the Technodrome is running low on liquid nitrogen, its main source of fuel, he discovers that a formula exists in Dimension Z which transmutes crude oil, easily available on Earth, into liquid nitrogen.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Shredderville
programme.desc: Because of all the destruction Shredder causes just trying to get rid of the Turtles, they lament that the world would be a better place had they never existed.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Bye - Bye Fly!
programme.desc: Plotting revenge, Baxter, who has been turned into a fly-like creature, delivers a borellium crystal to Krang and Shredder whose Technodrome is low in power.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Big Ripoff
programme.desc: The Technodrome is perilously close to running out of power as it teeters on the edge of a crumbling lava cliff deep within the bowels of the Earth.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Big Break-In
programme.desc: Krang and Shredder get the Technodrome rolling again and raise it to the centre of the Earth.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Big Blow-Out
programme.desc: Krang and Shredder raise the Technodrome to the surface and seize unlimited energy. The Turtles and the World face their darkest hour.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Plan Six from Outer Space
programme.desc: The Turtles launch the missile from the sewers positioned under the Technodrome. It transports Bebop, Rocksteady, Krang and Shredder back to Dimension X but explodes on impact; they survive.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Turtles of the Jungle
programme.desc: Donatello's idol, inventor mad-scientist Professor Willard creates the Molecular Intensifier, a machine to control growth of living things.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Michelangelo Toys Around
programme.desc: Michelangelo dreams he's being attacked by Tyranno-toys. He wakes up to hear April announcing the Toy Fair opening. Determined to go, Michelangelo disguises himself as a Turtle toy.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Peking Turtles
programme.desc: April O'Neil reports from the Uptown Museum about a display of artifacts from the 2000-year-old Ying Dynasty of China. The marble warriors were built to protect the world's largest pearl from being stolen from the Emperor's collection of jewels.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Shredder's Mother
programme.desc: The earth is experiencing global warming and Krang and Shredder threaten to expose it to increased catastrophic weather conditions.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Four Turtles and A Baby
programme.desc: The Neutrinos are attacked and their leaders, Zenter and Grizzla, are seized by Krang, Shredder and General Traag.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Turtlemaniac
programme.desc: Widespread thievery is discovered in the city when Ninja Turtle artifacts are found missing. April and Irma prowl for the pilfering poachers, the investigation leads the reporter to the estate of Monroe Q.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Rondo in New York
programme.desc: Word spreads that Oswald Oren, a nerdy Woody Allen-type student, has developed the Vitalizer - an experimental substance that brings inanimate objects to life. Scoundrels Shredder, Krang, Bebop and Rocksteady connive to steal the potion.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Planet of the Turtles
programme.desc: A commercial for the Personal Energy Projector (PEP), allowing the transfer of energy from one source to another, entices Krang. Targeting Earth, he drains the sphere's energy to strengthen the Technodrome.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Name That Toon
programme.desc: Krang threatens to vapourize the city by manipulating a Dematerializer, but a musical instrument that Howie, Irma's friend, plays around with, interferes with the device's programming.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Menace Maestro, Please
programme.desc: An invitation from April leads the Turtles, Irma and friend Howie to the haunted but renovated Floxy Music Hall, where the legendary Phantom of the Floxy resides.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Superhero for a Day
programme.desc: The half-shelled heroes find themselves competing with Bruce Bent, the Gadgetman, a self-proclaimed superhero from the past.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Back to the Egg
programme.desc: The foursome are dining out on their favourite food when Michelangelo and Leonardo are suddenly transformed into two five year-olds, thanks to Shredder's latest invention - an age-reversing serum.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Son of Return of the Fly II
programme.sub-title: Son of Return of the Fly II
programme.desc: After escaping from dimensional limbo, the Fly (alias Baxter Stockman) and his computer companion Z employ an experimental solid-energy generator to take over Channel Six.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Raphael Knocks 'Em Dead!
programme.desc: House of Ha comedians are disappearing, right in the middle of their acts.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Bebop and Rocksteady Conquer the Universe
programme.sub-title: Bebop and Rocksteady Conquer the Universe
programme.desc: When Bebop and Rocksteady steal the Anxietron Ray, they use it to scare the dickens out of everyone in their path, including the Turtles.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Raphael Meets His Match
programme.desc: Billionaire McDonald Crump makes the smallest pizzas in the world, and gives the biggest parties.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Slash - The Evil Turtles from Dimension X
programme.sub-title: Slash - The Evil Turtles from Dimension X
programme.desc: Using some of Shredder's and Krang's supercharged mutagen, Bebop and Rocksteady turn pet turtle Slash into an evil super mutant.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Leonardo Lightens Up
programme.desc: Tired of constant nagging about discipline, Raphael, Michelangelo and Donatello use a Personality Modifier on Leonardo to get him to lighten up.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Were-Rats of Channel Six
programme.desc: Finding a canister of unstable mutagen, the Rat King turns April and Vernon of Channel Six News into giant were-rats. As the transformed newshounds terrorize the city, Bebop and Rocksteady arrive to collect some explosives for Shredder and Krang.

programme.title: х/ф P. S. Я люблю тебя
programme.desc: Экранизация дебютного романа дочери ирландского премьер-министра Сесилии Ахерн. Тридцатилетняя Холли после смерти любимого мужа впадает в депрессию. Она замыкается в себе, перестает выходить из квартиры, общаться с людьми. Однажды в почтовом ящике Холли находит пакет с письмами… от своего любимого. Оказывается, зная о своей скорой смерти, он заранее подготовил десять писем, которые должны помочь Холи пережить утрату. А главное – научиться жить без него. С этого момента раз в месяц она должна распечатывать по одному конверту. Жизнь Холли превращается в ожидание первого числа, когда она сможет открыть очередное письмо. Муж просит ее купить себе новое платье, принять участие в конкурсе караоке или съездить на море. С каждым посланием она постепенно начинает вновь испытывать радость жизни… Реж.: Ричард ЛаГравенезе. В ролях: Хилари Суэнк, Джерард Батлер, Лиза Кудроу, Джина Гершон, Джеймс Марстерс, Кэти Бэйтс, Харри Конник-мл. Нелли МакКэй. США, 2007, мелодрама

programme.title: х/ф Образцовый самец 2
programme.desc: Жизненные обстоятельства вынуждают икону моды Дерека Зуландера стать затворником и жить вдали от всех. Но неожиданный визит Билли Зейна все меняет. Гость убеждает Дерека вернуться в мир моды и тем самым помочь себе восстановить опеку над сыном. С похожим предложением Билли обращается и к Хэнселу. Результатом этого становится возвращение двух культовых персон к публичной жизни. Однако показ модельера Дона Атари лишь подчеркивает тот факт, что Дерек и Хэнсел «застряли» в прошлом и сейчас никому не нужны. Несмотря на это, парочка получает приглашение на грандиозное мероприятие от Алексании Атоз, где помимо них будут все ведущие люди индустрии моды. Следом за этим к Дереку и Хэнселу обращается агент Интерпола Валентина. Она ведет расследование серии убийств поп-звезд. Валентина убеждена, что помочь выйти на след маньяка может лишь Зуландер… Реж.: Бен Стиллер. В ролях: Бен Стиллер, Оуэн Уилсон, Уилл Феррелл, Пенелопа Крус, Кристен Уиг, Фред Армисен, Кайл Муни, Милла Йовович, Кристин Тэйлор, Джастин Теру, Нэйтан Ли Грэм, Билли Зэйн. США, 2016, комедия

programme.title: х/ф Каспер
programme.desc: Каспер живет в особняке Уипстафф вместе с тремя другими призраками. Неожиданно в доме появляется новая хозяйка. Эта весьма неприятная особа получает особняк в наследство от отца. Женщина знает, что в доме где-то спрятан клад, который она непременно хочет найти. Ей отчаянно мешают привидения, не желающие отдавать сокровища и мечтающие выгнать злодейку со своей территории. Тогда женщина приглашает в дом доктора Харви – одного из лучших специалистов по привидениям, призракам и разной нечисти. Мистер Харви приезжает в особняк со своей дочкой-подростком Кэт. Милая, добрая девочка и очаровательное привидение становятся друзьями. Здесь самые интересные приключения только начинаются… Реж.: Брэд Силберлинг. В ролях: Кристина Риччи, Билл Пуллман, Кэти Мориарти, Эрик Айдл, Бен Стейн, Спенсер Врумэн, Чонси Леопарди, Уэсли Томпсон, Эми Бреннемэн, Девон Сава, Дон Новелло. США, 1995, комедия, фантазия

programme.title: м/ф Бивис и Батт-Хед уделывают Америку
programme.desc: Друзья-бездельники Бивис и Баттхед узнают страшную новость – кто-то украл их телевизор. Без этого устройства жизнь приятелей не имеет смысла, и они отправляются на поиски нового. Попытка забрать себе школьный телевизор заканчивается отчислением. Вскоре друзья узнают, что кабельное вещание есть в ближайшем мотеле, и проникают в один из номеров. Там они сталкиваются с брутальным и изрядно выпившим парнем Мадди. Он принимает школьников за киллеров, с которыми договорился встретиться, чтобы обсудить детали дела. Мадди просит Бивиса и Баттхеда полететь в Лас-Вегас и убить его жену Даллас. Они соглашаются, но неверно истолковывают суть задания – парни решают, что Мадди хочет, чтобы они переспали с его супругой. Заказчик сажает Бивиса и Баттхеда на самолет, вскоре после чего к нему приходят настоящие киллеры. Мадди понимает, что послал в Лас-Вегас самозванцев, и отправляется собственноручно убить их вместе с женой… Реж.: Майк Джадж. В ролях: Майк Джадж, Брюс Уиллис, Деми Мур, Клорис Личмэн, Роберт Стэк, Эрик Богосян, Грег Киннер, Тоби Хасс, Дэвид Леттерман. США, 1996, комедия, приключения

programme.title: х/ф P. S. Я люблю тебя
programme.desc: Экранизация дебютного романа дочери ирландского премьер-министра Сесилии Ахерн. Тридцатилетняя Холли после смерти любимого мужа впадает в депрессию. Она замыкается в себе, перестает выходить из квартиры, общаться с людьми. Однажды в почтовом ящике Холли находит пакет с письмами… от своего любимого. В ролях: Хилари Суэнк, Джерард Батлер, Лиза Кудроу, Джина Гершон, Джеймс Марстерс, Кэти Бэйтс, Харри Конник-мл. Нелли МакКэй. США, 2007, мелодрама

programme.title: х/ф Ужин с придурками
programme.desc: Простой служащий фирмы Тим получил своё первое приглашение на «ужин для придурков». Это ежемесячное мероприятие устраивает его босс, и тот, кто покажет себя самым большим идиотом, может рассчитывать на некоторые бонусы в будущем. Невеста Тима – Джули – находит всё это ужасным, и Тим соглашается пропустить ужин, но случайно знакомится с Барри – сотрудником налоговой службы, который в свободное время конструирует диорамы из чучел мышей. Тим приглашает с собой на ужин Барри, который становится причиной злоключений Тима. У него едва не срывается важная сделка, его бывшая подруга возвращается в его жизнь, а Джули попадает в объятия другого… Реж.: Джей Роуч. В ролях: Стив Карелл, Пол Радд, Зак Галифианакис, Джемэйн Клемент, Стефани Шостак, Люси Панч, Брюс Гринвуд, Дэвид Уоллиамс, Рон Ливингстон, Ларри Уилмор. США, 2010, комедия

programme.title: м/ф Карапузы встречаются с Торнберри
programme.desc: Карапузы – это Томми, Чаки, Фил и Лили, четыре малыша, для которых приключения – родная стихия. На этот раз они вместе с родителями отправляются в круиз на утлом суденышке, терпят кораблекрушение и попадают на необитаемый остров. Однако остров оказывается не совсем уж пустынным: известный путешественник и ведущий телепрограммы о животных Найджел Торнберри снимает здесь сюжет для очередной программы. Естественно, вся его семейка в сборе. Карапузам и Торберри предстоит поблуждать в джунглях, встретиться с леопардом, погрузиться на батискафе на дно океана и пережить множество удивительных приключений. Реж.: Джон Энг, Стивен Сандовал. В ролях: голоса: Элизабет Дэйли, Нэнси Картрайт, Лэйси Чэйберт, Тим Кэрри, Фли, Даниэлла Харрис, Брюс Уиллис. США, 2003

programme.title: х/ф Школа рока
programme.desc: Скандальный гитарист Дьюи Финн – ярый противник всех цивилизованных норм общества. Он намерен привести свой рок коллектив к победе в местной Битве групп, но его товарищи по группе выгоняют его из ансамбля. Голодающий, постоянно нуждающийся в деньгах, Дьюи случайно перехватывает телефонный звонок, адресованный его соседу по комнате Неду и неожиданно для самого себя соглашается заменить учителя в престижной «Horace Green Elementary School». Там за каждым шагом новичка, словно хищная птица, следит директор школы Муллинс. Но хотя Дьюи и не имеет понятия о том, как и что преподавать, он прекрасно знает, как внушить симпатию своим пятиклассникам. И, после того, как Дьюи случайно подслушал их репетицию во время урока музыки, он решил создать из этих юных музыкальных дарований новую рок-группу, которая навсегда изменит их и его жизни. Реж.: Ричард Линклэйтер. В ролях: Джек Блэк, Джоан Кьюсак, Майк Уайт, Сара Сильверман, Миранда Косгроув, Джои Гайдос-мл. Кевин Кларк, Ребекка Браун, Роберт Цай, Марьям Хассан, Адам Паскаль, Лукас Бэбин. США-Германия, 2003, комедия, музыкальный

programme.title: х/ф Городок Семетри
programme.desc: Англия, 1973 год. Городок Семетри – край настоящих работяг, где подростки бросают школу и идут прямиком на завод. Но молодому Фредди хочется от жизни большего, поэтому он не собирается идти по стопам своего отца. Парень устраивается в страховую компанию мистера Кендрика и верит в то, что сможет достичь таких же успехов. Несмотря на существенные перемены, Фредди продолжает водить дружбу со своими приятелями Брюсом и Полом, которые относятся к рабочему классу. Основная радость в их жизни сводится к выпивке и хулиганству. По этой причине Брюс бывает в полицейском участке чаще, чем у себя дома, где без дела сидит его отец-неудачник. А Пол, хоть и не является таким задирой и бунтарем, как его приятель, но к серьезным переменам не стремится. Поэтому со временем Фредди начинает смотреть на своих друзей иначе. А после того, как вновь встречает подругу детства Джули, и вовсе желает покинуть родной городок… Реж.: Рики Джервэйс, Стивен Мерчант. В ролях: Кристиан Кук, Фелисити Джонс, Том Хьюз, Джек Дулан, Энн Рид, Стив Спирс, Джулия Дэвис, Эмили Уотсон, Рики Джервэйс, Мэттью Гуд, Рэйф Файнс. Великобритания, 2010, комедия, драма

Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Season 4 of Hunting Land Man is starting off with a bang. In this episode, it’s opening week of turkey season in Mississippi, and these birds are doing it right. Cool mornings, gobbles breaking daylight, and longbeards fired up and on the move. We are fired up for the 2026 turkey season.

programme.title: hunting_land_man
programme.desc: It’s Caleb’s turn to hunt and Slade gets behind the camera. They encounter their target buck, but end up getting a shot at a different buck, and it’s a big boy.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Hunting Land Man keeps it rolling in the Mississippi woods. We’ve got some good buddies in camp this week, and it doesn’t take long for things to get interesting. One hunt ends in a tough miss, but we stay after it and bounce back with a longbeard hitting the dirt not long after. Later in the week, Slade’s wife Lori gets her first turkey of the year in an awesome hunt that came together just right. That’s just how it goes, what turkey hunting is all about, some ups, some downs, and a whole lot of good times. Season 4 is heating up.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Watch as Lori tags her first turkey of the season as well as the daily grind and comments from the office in McComb, Mississippi. The ladies in the office isn’t too fond of turkey season until it’s their turn.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode of Hunting Land Man, Asa is on a roll. She fills her second and third turkey tags of the year, capping off an incredible season and tagging out in Mississippi. The highlight of the week came when she got to experience her very first double-up with her dad, Slade. Sharing a moment like that in the turkey woods is something they'll never forget, making this a truly unforgettable hunt.

programme.desc: During this episode of Ship Shape TV Essentials the SSTV team - showcases structural fiberglass repairs and teak refinishing on various project boats, including non-skid walkway applications.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, we introduce Slade Priest, the Hunting Land Man. Slade is a realtor for Realtree United Country out of the Southern States office in Mccomb, MS. He's hosted outdoor hunting shows in the past such as Trained Assassins and Realtree's Hunt United. He's also been featured in Realtree's Monster Bucks several times. In this new series, we'll be covering all things from rack bucks to real estate. We hope we can help you learn more about land and investments during this process and enjoy watching some great hunting content!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode Slade gets very busy in the real estate world. But lucky for him, Caleb Armstrong takes up the slack. Caleb sets out to hunt swamp bucks on the public land of Tensas Parish.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode we turkey hunt here in southwest Mississippi with Cragg Fitz from Trained Assassins TV. It's the opening week of turkey season in Mississippi and the birds are gobbling and looking for love. They whip us on opening morning but we stumble upon one that afternoon and make our move and he makes his! You won't want to miss this episode!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, we chase the hardheaded turkeys of Southwest Mississippi. We've got a strand of bad weather coming, and a lot to catch up on in Real Estate so it's going to be our last hunt for awhile. We get set up on these two gobblers we've been following all year and then a surprise bird comes out of nowhere (Randy Orton Style). You will not want to miss this episode!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode we show you how we handle selling real estate in the midst of turkey season. When it is time to chase turkeys, our productivity as agents definitely slows a little bit, so that means we have to spend more hours ensuring our clients get what they deserve from us. We bounce around in this one going from taking the kids to school, handling business at the office, showing an amazing property, and finally getting some time to hunt. We hope this episode gives you a bit more insight on just how hectic and fast paced our Springs are at Hunting Land Man in Southwest Mississippi.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, we take you to historic Saint Francisville, Louisiana. We closed on a couple of real estate properties in this area and want to show you why this area is so unique from a recreational standpoint. This place holds the “old south” feel that is ever so fleeting. We hunt on a property I sold to a client last year in Saint Francisville and manage to get a beautiful longbearded turkey on the ground. This episode is one you definitely don’t want to miss.

programme.title: Storytellers

programme.title: Storytellers

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We are blessed for the opportunity to follow along the guys from Trinity Oaks for Bucks for the Brave. The men and women that served in our armed services and as first responders, had jobs that required the, to be willing to sacrifice their own lives every day, in order to protect or save someone else's. Not many of us can say that, nor understand what that truly means. The things they've had to see, and the sacrifices they've made in their daily lives, can have a profound impact on them. Trinity Oaks' Bucks for the Brave platform allows the loved ones and communities that support these heroes to share their stories and unite us all in honoring and recognizing their service to our great nation. We are proud to continue to be a part of this incredible program, getting these heroes in the outdoors for the hunt of a lifetime.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Join us for an unforgettable Women Go Hunting experience at Legends Ranch in Michigan!

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors
programme.desc: Capt. Blair heads up to Steinhatchee after getting a call from local tournament angler Jay Andrew. The reds have been popping off and so the two head out in search.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors
programme.desc: The second day in Steinhatchee, Capt. Blair & Jay finally find where all the reds got off too, and I mean ALL the reds. This is one of the craziest sights on the show yet.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors
programme.desc: Highlights from Capt. Blair's recent travels.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors
programme.desc: While up in Alaska, the crew caught more fish than we had time to show so here's another look at some of the fish that were caught on the Alaskan trip.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle explores the Great Lakes on his Sea-Doo in search of walleye and lake trout.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle Green and his buddy Jeremy set out on a buffalo hunt in the great state of Oklahoma. Along the way they learn about the true past and potential future of the American Buffalo from several interesting people with different perspectives.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle Green heads to Yankton, South Dakota to learn about the history of the Missouri river and the people who count on the river for sustenance. The invasive carp are set to destroy this rich ecosystem and Kyle aims to stop this fish with his best weapon, a great recipe.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle Green meets up with his friends at the National Wild Turkey Federation to dive into turkey conservation, and hunt the largest subspecies of wild turkey. Kyle finishes off this episode with his most favorite wild game recipe, boneless wild turkey wings.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: The first cool snap rolled into Georgia over the weekend, and the Road Trips crew headed out to the woods in full force. A few does hit the dirt. Plus, Tyler Jordan just barely missed a double drop tine giant that showed up 40 minutes after he climbed out of his treestand on Sunday night.

programme.title: Road Trips - "15 Yard Bow kill | Pitts on the Board with a Giant Nine | Realtree Road Trips"
programme.desc: Michael Pitts ends a two-year quest on a giant deer in Harris County, Georgia. Better yet, it's a great, big bow buck. What a hunt! Follow along as he finishes the story on an old whitetail.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Realtree's Ben McDonald gets luck again on his first sit in Nebraska. This time he rattles in an absolute giant whitetail into Bow Range.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: The Road Trips crew is out hunting from Iowa down to Georgia! The guys are joined by Joel Burham of Whitetail Fit and Josh Sparks of MidWest Whitetail. The pre rut action is getting hot and Charlie Thomas puts down his hit list 10 pointer!

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Ben McDonald heads back to Nebraska this time to freezing temp and snow. Ben is after a huge bodied buck that has started to show up on trail cameras. He is hoping the first time into the area is the charm as he bow hunts this Nebraska Giant Buck!

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Riley Green heads down to South Louisiana to finish out duck and deer season. The first morning duck hunt was absolutely epic with a 7 man limit at 7:35 am. Day 3 in the deer blind proved to be all Riley needed to close out his deer season with a big, wide 10 point!

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Across the country, deer season to many Americans is a rite of passage. For generations, Winchester has been the trusted ammunition choice for hunters…and it’s been a decade since the game-changing Deer Season XP whitetail line was introduced. In this episode, we’ll celebrate the many successes by Team Winchester hunters in the field during whitetail and mule deer firearm seasons across the United States. - GUESTS: Melissa Bachman (Team Winchester) Mark Drury (Team Winchester) Nikki Boxler (Team Winchester) Chris Keefer (Team Winchester) Casey Keefer (Team Winchester) Jason Gilbertson (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The mission of Shoot United is to be a content resource for millions of shooters and a place where people can learn, build confidence and find ways to participate. Through films, educational videos and articles, SU has impacted countless shooters all over the world. In this episode, join Shoot United Ambassadors as they inspire and educate through a series of instructional videos and stories in pistol, self-defense, trap and skeet and sporting clays. - GUESTS: Thea Van Sync (Team Winchester) Callie Farill (Team Winchester) Becky Yackley (Team Winchester) Theo Ribbs (Team Winchester) Jessica Hook (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Illinois isn’t the first state you think about when it comes to waterfowl, but the Wentz Brothers have dialed in some honey holes over the years. On this episode, a slew of waterfowl experts put to the test some of the newest Winchester waterfowl ammunition during the great migration of the Mississippi Flyway in early December. We’ll also head north to the shores of Kodiak Island, Alaska with Chris and Casey Keefer as they push the limits of Winchester’s new Last Call Double Shot on fast-ripping sea ducks. - GUESTS: Zach Wentz (Team Winchester) Nathan Robinson (Winchester Ammunition) Ryan Swaner (Winchester Repeating Arms) Chris Jennings (Ducks Unlimited) Mike Brasher (Ducks Unlimited) Scott Olmsted (American Hunter) Travis Hall (Field & Stream) Chris Keefer (Team Winchester) Casey Keefer (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Col. Nick Nichols from Folds of Honor and Olympic skeet shooter Dania Vizzi are both proud Americans who have represented their country overseas. Col. Nichols commanded the air in the cockpit of a fighter jet for countless missions during his seven combat tours and Dania donned the stars and bars proudly on her shooting vest as an Olympian in Paris. Now with Winchesters in hand, both are in the Midwest whitetail woods during late November during the back end of the rut hoping to connect on a Missouri monarch.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Steeped in history, Dan Cabela travels to Spain and France to learn more about chamois and how hunting helped to recover declining populations. He learns how local development, conservation and brown bear research are funded by regulated hunting.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: The introduction of non-native species into Australia has had a large impact on native species. Ongoing management throughout the country is a daily task. Dan Cabela meets some of the people taking on this challenge.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 1 of the British episodes, Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the beautiful venison that Michelin star chef, Mark Robinson has to offer. He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: As part of this year's Star brite Sea Safe event, we hit the water to experience some of the incredible fishing the Indian River Lagoon has to offer. For Rush, that meant some serious bow time with close friend Alex Hughey - on the hunt for some of the biggest snook we've ever encountered. The bite wasn't easy, but that didn't stop Rush from smashing his personal best - not once, but twice - in one unforgettable day on the water. Don't miss this action-packed episode of the Sea Safe adventure from beautiful Sebastian, Florida!

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: For Capt. Justin Leake, sight fishing the beach is one of the most productive, and FUN ways to fish. When that doesn’t work, Capt. Todd Jones suggests fishing an artificial reef, and as it turns out, that’s where dinner lives.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: "Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor patiently pursue big tarpon from the Everglades to the Middle Keys with fly rod in hand."

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor are joined by Florida Keys guide Richard Black for an exciting adventure in Key Largo, catching a wide variety of fish species on the shallow reef.

programme.desc: No danger too high or too hot for the Hellfire heroes!

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E07 - Naturally Fascinating
programme.desc: Bolivia is a country of countless fascinating natural sights. We will begin on the high plateau of Altiplano, stopping by the world’s largest salt lake.Later, we will descend a few thousand meters using the road of death to the Los Yungas province. And then on to the shores of lake Titicaca, the highest navigable lake in the world.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E08 - Naturally Harmonious
programme.desc: Zambia, the Latvian region of Kurzeme, the Georgian provinces of Kakheti and Svaneti, seem to have very little in common. They lie in Africa, Europe and on the borderline between Europe and Asia respectively. Kakheti and Svaneti are both a part of Georgia but very unlike one another. So where is the connection? How are these regions similar?

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E09 - Naturally Spiritual
programme.desc: In this episode we visit two different corners of our planet. Although thousands of kilometres apart, spiritually they are close relatives. First, Ethiopia in East Africa which is dissected by the Great African Rift Valley and considered by many to be the cradle of humankind. Next, a paradise on Earth: Jamaica.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E38 - HM The Queen A Remarkable Life
programme.desc: The most notable woman in modern times has to be our Late Queen, Elizabeth II. She ruled for 70 years, the longest reign in British history. Once a princess who wasn't supposed to be queen, Elizabeth II led the country to thrive after World War II and became a steady presence in our changing world. In a thousand years of British monarchy, Elizabeth II is likely one of the most outstanding monarchs ever.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E41 - Fergie The Downfall Of A Modern Duchess
programme.desc: Sarah Ferguson, once known as the Duchess of York, seemed to have everything, but her world turned upside down when her name got caught up in a big scandal.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E09 - Head to Head
programme.desc: With the arctic storm nipping at their heals, the Keefer brothers race down the river to reach their next supply-yielding cache only to become lost as the river divides into a maze of small channels.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E10 - Edge of the Storm
programme.desc: As the temperature plummets, the Keefer brothers fight their way down stream through freezing water and strong headwinds as they hope to reach their extraction site before the arctic storm lays claim to it.

programme.title: Wardens - S09:E03 - Serving Warrants and Ice Fishing
programme.desc: Michigan Conservation Officers serve warrants to a suspect believed to have taken at least eighteen deer without licenses.

programme.title: Wardens - S09:E04 - Michigan Bears
programme.desc: Michigan Conservation Officers enforce bear hunting regulations in a variety of ways; the state's DNR uses many methods to track the state's bear numbers.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E03 - Cunning Copulation
programme.desc: Finding a mate, building a nest, and raising kids are all part of the whole reproductive behavior thing. But it’s not as easy as it sounds. First, you’ve got to sift through lots of possible partners to find the one with the best genes to keep your family line going. programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 8

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 9

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 10
programme.desc: All is quiet at Leopard's Den as Sarah, Evan and Olivia gather at the hospital. Danny has been given the all clear to go home. But Du Plessis is still unconscious and seriously ill. Caroline keeps a tender vigil at his bedside.
